title: Crazyflie · Webots↔Renode bridge
description: JSONL telemetry of the drone_firm_monitoring bridge, ingested with bridge_to_influx.py

list.name: drone
list.label: Drone
list.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "bridge_cycle" and r._field == "cycle")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: (if exists r.drone then r.drone else "(untagged)")}))
  |> group()
  |> distinct(column: "_value")
list.definition:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "bridge_cycle" and r._field == "cycle")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: (if exists r.drone then r.drone else "(untagged)")}))
  |> group()
  |> distinct(column: "_value")

panels.title: Altitude (last value)
panels.description: Last plant altitude (Webots GPS) in the selected time range and drones.

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "bridge_cycle" and r._field == "alt")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: (if exists r.drone then r.drone else "(untagged)"), set: ${drone:json}))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with drone: (if exists r.drone then r.drone else "(untagged)")}))
  |> group(columns: ["drone"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_value", "drone"])

panels.title: Mean loop rate
